status: Four final native captures inspected; scoped image evidence, not complete readability or performance acceptance.
observations: Both variants retain low-poly bodies; Tainted has a larger dark head and ordinary a lighter head.
Red radial projectiles, their shadows and cosmetic blood marks are visible on canyon ground.
The incorrect aimed warning line is absent.
An early-frame background lamp visually intersects the enemy silhouette; it is scenery, not part of the model.
At close contact the player and enemy overlap, obscuring facial detail and weakening silhouette readability.
These captures do not establish crowded encounter readability, color-vision accessibility or complete attack telegraph quality.
Displayed 9–12 FPS was captured during concurrent compilation and is not controlled performance evidence.
Browser captures preserve ordinary light and Tainted dark silhouettes; the Tainted isolated windup capture occurs during a white damage flash.
Automatic ring capture selects the first emission frame, when projectiles are still at the body. Trace evidence establishes the volley; these images alone do not demonstrate its spread.
Actual generated canyon rooms include nearby actors, walls, river and cover. Actor overlap and scenery still obscure some details; no complete crowded readability claim.
